Subject: Mutual Action Playbook: ops sprint, canary catalog & training cadence

Hi Ava & Luke —

Thanks again for the signature — excited to get MedicaPro onboarded. I pulled together a first-pass Mutual Action Playbook (attached) that embeds the post-signature implementation plan: rollout windows, a small-run canary catalog, migration gating, and the training cohort schedule. High-level asks below; the attached MAP has owner-level rows for commitments we discussed.

Quick highlights:
- Week 0 (this week): sandbox provisioning + security intake (we need your SOC2 contact to finish evidence).
- Week 1-2: canary phase (3 model variants, 2 traffic shards) with daily checkpoints.
- Week 3-4: broader migration ramp; training cohort sessions (hands-on + runbook handoff).
- Acceptance: 48-hour stability window after migration + success criteria in the MAP (latency <120ms p50 on test set, error rate <0.5%).

Open items for your team:
1) Confirm sandbox dataset access (S3 prefix or SFTP?) and who will be our security contact for the questionnaire.
2) Pick two preferred training slots (we have mornings Tue/Thu or afternoons Mon/Wed).
3) Any hard blackout dates for migration in September.

Attachments: MAP-MedicaPro-v1.0.xlsx, canary-catalog-and-checklist.pdf

I
Irene Choi
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0243

Irene — thanks for the plan and the attachments. We're good to proceed on the high-level timeline with a couple of asks:

- Sandbox: we'll provision an S3 bucket and can provide access keys; I'll attach the bucket path in my next email.
- Security intake: please send the short SOC2 checklist to secops@medicapro.com — they'll need a week to respond.
- Rollback/contingency: can you confirm a rollback playbook? We need an explicit route to revert model traffic to our current endpoint without data loss.

Training slots: prefer Tue morning + Wed afternoon (if you can do two separate cohorts).

Also: small ask on canary traffic split — can we start with 3% of traffic for variant A, 1% for B, and 1% for C (total 5%)? We want a conservative ramp.

Thanks,
Luke

Quick internal update and recommendations based on Luke's asks:

- Canary catalog: propose three variants (A: base open model quantized, B: lower-latency tuned variant, C: safety-filtered variant). We'll start with 3%/1%/1% traffic split, and validate on metric streams (latency, response quality, safety flags).
- Rollback: implement fast rollback via routing policy at the gateway layer — we keep previous model pinned, and traffic can be entirely re-routed within 5 minutes. Document attached: canary-catalog-and-checklist.pdf (section 4).
- Owners (proposed):
  - Provisioning & security intake: Monica Patel (owner)
  - Canary orchestration & monitoring: Markus Klein (owner)
  - Training & runbook handoff: Karthik Iyer (owner)
  - Customer success & sign-off: Irene Choi (owner)

Action: Monica, can you confirm you can take the security intake with MedicaPro secops and estimate time to finish?

-karthik

- Training: Tue morning + Wed afternoon works; please confirm session durations and whether sessions will be recorded. We need one live hands-on (90 min) + one Q&A (45 min).
